question_text: How should evaluation packets represent static-only versus execution-backed confidence without overclaiming readiness?
goal: Define the minimum evaluation-strength contract fields and gate behavior needed before planner and code scopes rely on candidate evaluations.
decision_target: whether to add evaluation_strength and evaluation_method semantics to research_evaluation_packet and downstream recommendation gates
decision_consequence: changes whether static candidate evaluation can be distinguished from execution-backed validation before planner entry
blocked_work_if_unanswered: planner and code-generation scopes may overtrust static evaluations and drift into unsupported quality claims
constraints: must not require planner artifacts before planner exists
why_now: The current validation run is operational but still uses static candidate evaluation.
expected_downstream_change: Recommendations and selected scopes can distinguish static-only evidence from execution-backed evidence.
